strongest_angle: Examine the collapse of the eighth Moscow Format Consultations and the subsequent border clashes along Paktia province and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province.

key_facts.fact: The eighth round of the Moscow Format Consultations on Afghanistan collapsed without a joint statement on October 5, following a clash between Pakistan's special representative and Taliban foreign minister Amir Khan Muttaqi.

Following the failed talks in Moscow, reported fighting between the Taliban and Pakistan has involved border clashes along Afghanistan's southeastern Paktia province and Pakistan's northwestern Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province.
The United Nations Mission in Afghanistan stated in September that it had documented more than 1,100 civilian deaths and injuries from cross-border violence.
Pakistan's federal government has declared a state of emergency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa amid escalating security tensions along the border.
